_comment: CANONICAL CAI Master Control Library (MCL). One list for every agent package and for all four assurance dimensions. Edited only through a reviewed PR; tests/cai-mcl.test.mjs checks its structure. References marked '(reference)' or '(indicative)' are mappings for orientation, not claims that the instrument applies or is met. ISO/IEC 42001 references are to clauses and Annex A objectives and must be verified against a licensed copy of the standard before the MCL is approved.

dimensions.PC: Product certification: the release as built and shipped, assessed against the MCL. Per release; prerequisite for any sale.
dimensions.SC: Active Continuous Certification subscription coverage: keeping a certified release current while the subscription is active.
dimensions.DA: Customer deployment assurance: whether the customer's installation matches the certified configuration. Customer-run with ColleagueAI's kit.
dimensions.OC: Customer operational compliance: the customer's own legal and operational duties. Never certified by ColleagueAI.

obligations.M: Mandatory provider obligation. Owed for every certified release and every affected licensee, regardless of subscription.
obligations.L: Perpetual licence entitlement. Part of what every buyer of the version receives, for the life of the licence.
obligations.S: Incremental subscription benefit. Only while a Continuous Certification subscription is active.
obligations.C: Customer responsibility. ColleagueAI supplies guidance only and does not verify or certify it.

roles.FC: Founder, commercial (approver, customer and authority communication)
roles.SGB: Student group B (mappings, documentation, evidence templates)

domains.name: Governance, accountability and CAI tier classification
Documentation, instructions for use and statement of applicability
Privacy and data protection by design
Data governance, lineage, quality and knowledge integrity
AI model lifecycle and Microsoft platform compatibility
Operational resilience, recovery, rollback and safe decommissioning
Responsible AI, fairness, accessibility and human rights

Business value, performance and AI Token Economy benchmarking

controls.title: Programme ownership and change control
controls.requirement: A named programme owner and approver are recorded; the MCL is versioned and changes only through a reviewed pull request with an independent approving review.

controls.title: CAI tier classification per release
controls.requirement: Each release records its CAI tier (L1-L5) and the rationale; re-assessed on every change that touches autonomy, actions or data reach.
controls.evidence: agent record cai.targetLevel; dossier tier rationale

controls.title: AI system impact assessment
controls.requirement: An impact and risk assessment per release covers intended purpose, affected persons, foreseeable misuse and residual risk, with named treatment for each risk above 'low'.
controls.evidence: impact assessment in the evidence library

controls.title: High-risk and prohibited-practice screening
controls.requirement: Each intended purpose is screened against AI Act Art. 5 and Annex III; any 'possibly high-risk' result is confirmed by counsel before sale and changes the package's obligations.
controls.evidence: screening record; counsel note where required
references: AI Act Art. 5, Art. 6, Annex III

controls.title: Accountable human role in the package
controls.requirement: The package defines the customer role accountable for the agent and the decisions it may not take alone.

controls.title: Defined stop points
controls.requirement: Every action with legal, financial or external effect is listed and requires a named human approval; a regression case proves the agent cannot complete it without approval.

controls.title: Stop and override
controls.requirement: A documented way to pause the agent and its flows is tested on each release.

controls.title: Customer oversight assignment
controls.requirement: The customer assigns oversight persons with the competence and authority to act; the deployment kit records who.

controls.title: AI interaction disclosure
controls.requirement: End users are told they interact with an AI system at the start of each conversation; a regression case checks the text.

controls.title: Synthetic content marking: applicability assessment
controls.requirement: For each package, a recorded assessment states whether it generates synthetic audio, image, video or text within Art. 50(2), whether an exception applies (for example assistive editing that does not substantially alter the input), and whether any transitional period is available, which is the case only where its eligibility conditions are met (per the adopted text, systems already placed on the market before 2 Aug 2026). Counsel confirms it before the package is first placed on the market; where Art. 50(2) applies, marking ships in the first release.

controls.title: Unverified content labelling
controls.requirement: Extracted or generated content not yet confirmed by a human is labelled as unverified wherever shown.

controls.title: Customer notices to affected persons
controls.requirement: The customer gives any notice its own context requires (employees, counterparties).

controls.title: Audit event schema
controls.requirement: Each release fixes the audit events and fields it emits; a regression case checks that every field is written.

controls.title: Audit data stays with the customer
controls.requirement: Audit records are stored only in the customer's tenant; ColleagueAI has no access path.

controls.title: Customer retention setting
controls.requirement: The customer sets audit retention to its own policy; the kit states the default and how to change it.

controls.title: Release documentation set
controls.requirement: Dossier, install guide, known limitations, START-HERE, control map and the release-time evidence summary ship with every release and are listed in its SHA256SUMS.

controls.title: Statement of applicability
controls.requirement: Every MCL control is marked applicable or not applicable to the release, with the reason and the evidence reference; produced from one template.
controls.evidence: SoA file in the release evidence

controls.title: Documentation retention
controls.requirement: Documentation for each released version stays available to its licensees for the life of the licence and at least 10 years after the version was last sold.

controls.title: Regulatory source register
controls.requirement: The instruments in the covered scope (I-1 to I-4), Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform notices (compatibility and breaking changes) and the frameworks in the applicability matrix are scanned weekly and every relevant item is logged.

controls.title: Statutory-change triage
controls.requirement: Each logged change is classed within 10 business days: statutory obligation on ColleagueAI as provider, change to the CAI standard, or no effect.

controls.title: Statutory remediation for all licensees
controls.requirement: Where a change creates a legal obligation on ColleagueAI as provider of a shipped version, the remediation goes to every affected licensee, subscribed or not.

controls.title: Published change assessment
controls.requirement: For each in-scope change, an assessment (triggers a release / does not, and why) is published against the affected certificates within 30 days of the change taking effect or being published.

controls.title: Certified update availability
controls.requirement: Where an assessment triggers a release, the updated certified release is made available within 60 days of the trigger, or before the change's own deadline if later.

controls.title: Repository security scanning
controls.requirement: CodeQL, dependency audit and secret scanning run on every change; high or critical findings block the merge or carry a dated, approved exception.

controls.title: Package scan before release
controls.requirement: The package is scanned for secrets, tenant identifiers and personal data before release.

controls.title: Least privilege and isolation
controls.requirement: Connections use the least privilege documented; a second-user test proves no cross-user or cross-team access.

controls.title: Prompt-injection and misuse test set
controls.requirement: A shared adversarial set (injection, jailbreak, data exfiltration, instruction override) runs on every release; critical cases must all pass.

controls.title: Security support period
controls.requirement: The security support period (24 months) is stated in the licence and on the disclosure page.

controls.title: Vulnerability and incident intake
controls.requirement: security@ and security.txt are live; every report is acknowledged within 2 business days with a reference, whether or not the reporter is a customer.

controls.title: Security and AI incident register
controls.requirement: Every report and incident is logged with severity (CVSS for security; CAI AI-incident class for behaviour), owner and dates, and closed with a root cause.

controls.title: CRA reporting: early warning, notification, final report
controls.requirement: For an actively exploited vulnerability or a severe incident affecting a package: early warning within 24 h of becoming aware; notification within 72 h; final report within 14 days after a corrective or mitigating measure is available (vulnerability) or within one month after the incident notification (severe incident); intermediate reports when requested; affected users informed without undue delay with mitigations. Submitted through the ENISA Single Reporting Platform to the coordinating CSIRT; account and submission path registered before the first sale (CRA set-up item C6).
controls.evidence: SRP submission references and timestamps in the security register; user notification log

controls.title: Notice to all affected licensees
controls.requirement: Every affected licensee is notified with mitigation and the corrective release, regardless of subscription status.

controls.title: Corrective release
controls.requirement: Security fixes and defect corrections ship as corrective releases of the purchased line at no further licence fee during the support period.

controls.title: Learning loop
controls.requirement: Every closed incident adds or updates at least one regression case.

controls.title: Deployer serious-incident duties
controls.requirement: The customer reports serious incidents that arise in its use where the law requires; ColleagueAI supports with facts about the package.
references: AI Act Art. 26(5), Art. 73 (deployer, where high-risk)

controls.title: Personal-data inventory per package
controls.requirement: Each package lists the personal data it can process, where it is stored (customer tenant) and for what purpose.

controls.title: No provider access to customer data
controls.requirement: ColleagueAI is not given access to customer data by the package; any support access is granted by the customer, time-bound and under a written agreement, never automatic.

controls.title: DPIA input pack
controls.requirement: A standard input for the customer's DPIA (data, risks, controls) ships with the package.

controls.title: Synthetic test data only
controls.requirement: Development, testing and benchmarking use synthetic data only.

controls.title: Knowledge source declaration
controls.requirement: Every grounding source, connector and expected document format is declared with its owner role.

controls.title: Lineage to source
controls.requirement: Every extracted value and every answer that cites data is traceable to the source document and location; a regression case checks this.

controls.title: Quality thresholds
controls.requirement: Per-field accuracy on the golden dataset meets the release threshold recorded in the release record, with no drop over 2 percentage points against the previous certified release.

controls.title: Knowledge integrity
controls.requirement: Superseded, stale and unverified content is handled as documented (superseded marking, unverified labels, refusal to quote unconfirmed text as verbatim).

controls.title: Customer source curation
controls.requirement: The customer curates knowledge sources and their permissions; the kit lists the checks.

controls.title: Model and platform dependency record
controls.requirement: Each release records the generative settings, orchestration mode, AI Builder models and Microsoft features it depends on, as far as Microsoft exposes them.

controls.title: Model change detection
controls.requirement: Microsoft model, orchestration and feature changes announced for Copilot Studio and Power Platform are logged weekly against the dependency records.

controls.title: Re-evaluation on model change
controls.requirement: After a logged model change that can affect C-1 to C-5, the golden and security sets are re-run within 30 days and the result is published as a change assessment.

controls.title: Safety defect from model change
controls.requirement: If a re-run shows a safety or security defect, the fix ships as a corrective release to all licensees in the support period.

controls.title: Configuration under version control
controls.requirement: Prompts, topics, flows and settings ship only inside the managed solution of the release; no unmanaged changes in released packages.

controls.title: Component inventory (SBOM)
controls.requirement: Each release lists its Microsoft services, connectors, third-party components and licences in machine-readable form.
references: CRA Annex I part II (from 11 Dec 2027)

controls.title: Connector risk classification
controls.requirement: Each connector is classed by data reach, authentication and recommended DLP group.

controls.title: Provider supplier register
controls.requirement: ColleagueAI's own suppliers (Microsoft, GitHub, Vercel, Upstash, Resend, Stripe) are listed with role, location and DPA status.

controls.title: Third-party vulnerability watch
controls.requirement: Advisories for repository dependencies and Microsoft platform security are watched; relevant ones enter the incident register.

controls.title: Customer environment policies
controls.requirement: The customer applies DLP, environment and connector policies; the kit lists the recommended settings.

controls.title: Mandatory release gates
controls.requirement: All 17 mandatory release gates pass with recorded evidence before a release can be sold.

controls.title: Central regression suite
controls.requirement: One regression suite (functional golden set, oversight, transparency, audit, lineage, security cases) is maintained centrally and run on CAI-TEST for every release and every change assessment that touches the package.

controls.title: Regression acceptance
controls.requirement: Zero failed critical cases; non-critical pass rate at or above the threshold in the release record; every failure has a ticket.

controls.title: Clean install and workflow
controls.requirement: Clean install and the end-to-end workflow pass on a clean environment.

controls.title: Upgrade from the previous certified release
controls.requirement: Upgrade preserves data, configuration and flow states.

controls.title: Package integrity
controls.requirement: Package SHA-256, bytes and bundle revision equal the release record; any mismatch refuses sale.

controls.title: Version-pinned access
controls.requirement: Licensees keep access to the purchased version and its corrective releases through signed, version-pinned downloads.

controls.title: Certified update delivery
controls.requirement: A certified update is published as a new release through the same pipeline; the customer decides whether and when to install it. ColleagueAI never pushes or installs into a customer environment.

controls.title: Release notes
controls.requirement: Every release states what changed, why (statutory, CAI standard, defect, security) and which controls are affected.

controls.title: Rollback procedure
controls.requirement: A tested procedure returns a customer to the previous certified release, including how data is preserved (a managed solution cannot be downgraded in place).

controls.title: Safe decommissioning
controls.requirement: Uninstall removes all components and connections and lists any residual data for the customer to delete.

controls.title: No runtime dependency on ColleagueAI
controls.requirement: Installed agents keep working if ColleagueAI's website or services are unavailable: no phone-home, no remote disabling.

controls.title: Commercial kill switches
controls.requirement: Checkout, per-product sale approval, interest collection and certificate status each fail closed and are tested in CI.

controls.title: Programme or package discontinuation
controls.requirement: On discontinuation: notice, cancellation with pro-rata refund, documentation kept available, and the certificate marked discontinued; the perpetual licence is unaffected.

controls.title: Customer backup and recovery
controls.requirement: The customer backs up agent data under its own policy; the kit names the tables and files.

controls.title: Intended purpose and prohibited uses
controls.requirement: Each package states its intended purpose, out-of-scope uses and prohibited uses.

controls.title: Fairness relevance and evaluation
controls.requirement: Each package is screened for decisions affecting people; where relevant, the golden set is evaluated per group on synthetic data and gaps above the threshold block release.

controls.title: Accessibility target
controls.requirement: Package-owned interfaces (cards, apps, documents) are checked against key WCAG 2.1 AA criteria; known gaps are listed. Stated as a design target, not a conformance claim.

controls.title: Fundamental-rights input
controls.requirement: Where a customer must carry out a fundamental-rights impact assessment, the package provides the facts it needs.

controls.title: AI literacy material
controls.requirement: Short user and administrator guidance ships with the package; the customer remains responsible for its staff's AI literacy.

controls.title: Separation of build and certification
controls.requirement: The person who built a release does not take its certification decision; a qualified independent reviewer reviews the evidence pack before a release is listed as certified.

controls.title: Reviewer qualification and independence
controls.requirement: Reviewers meet the published qualification criteria, sign a conflict-of-interest declaration (no build role, no sales commission, no financial interest), renewed yearly.

controls.title: Certificate status: separate axes
controls.requirement: The certificate record keeps four separate states: subscription (active, past_due, cancelled, lapsed); release currency (current certified release, superseded, withdrawn); certificate decision (valid, suspended, revoked, discontinued); customer-reported deployment (not reported, version in use). The public label 'Colleague AI Certified — Active' requires all of: subscription active and in term, certified version is the current certified release of its package, decision valid. An active subscription alone never shows Active. No personal data is shown.

controls.title: Historic certification record
controls.requirement: The certification record of each released version as at its release remains verifiable for licensees after a subscription lapses, shown as 'certified at release, not current'.

controls.title: Suspension and revocation
controls.requirement: Published criteria: suspension for an unmitigated critical vulnerability over 30 days, a failed critical regression case, or misuse of the mark; revocation for falsified evidence or unfixable non-conformity. Notice before action except in emergencies.

controls.title: Complaints and appeals
controls.requirement: A customer or third party can contest a certification decision; decided within 30 days by a founder not involved in the build together with the reviewer.

controls.title: Annual programme review
controls.requirement: The reviewer reviews the programme once a year against this MCL; a summary of findings and actions is published.

controls.title: AI Token Economy benchmark protocol
controls.requirement: A fixed synthetic workload per package is run on CAI-TEST, measuring Copilot Studio consumption per business transaction, latency (p50, p95) and task success rate.

controls.title: Consumption change report
controls.requirement: For subscribers, each benchmark run is compared with the previous certified release; a consumption increase above 15% or a success-rate drop above 2 points is flagged in the evidence report. Priority operational deliverable from the dry run; contractual only after the dry run validates delivery capacity (spec §4.2).

controls.title: Illustrative value model
controls.requirement: The business value model states its assumptions and customer-adjustable inputs and is labelled illustrative; no guaranteed return is stated.

controls.title: Customer consumption monitoring
controls.requirement: The customer monitors its own capacity use in the Power Platform admin center; the kit shows where.

controls.title: Standardised evidence report
controls.requirement: One report template per package, assembled from release records, change assessments, regression and benchmark results; issued quarterly to active subscribers. The release-time evidence summary ships to every buyer as part of the documentation set (D05-01). Priority operational deliverable from the dry run; contractual only after the dry run validates delivery capacity (spec §4.2).

mappingStatus.verified: Checked against the official text of the cited edition by a named checker, with date. Required before a reference appears in any customer-facing material.
mappingStatus.indicative: Prepared by ColleagueAI and not yet checked against the official text. Internal only.
mappingStatus.future: Planned coverage for a later MCL version or an obligation not yet applicable.

AIA.name: EU AI Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by the Digital Omnibus on AI (2026)
AIA.applies: Yes: ColleagueAI is provider of AI systems. Art. 4 and Art. 5 apply now; Art. 50 since 2 Aug 2026; Chapter III high-risk duties only if a package's intended purpose is screened as Annex III (from 2 Dec 2027).

GDPR.name: GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679
GDPR.applies: Yes: to ColleagueAI's own processing (website, interest, orders). Customer is controller for data its agents process; ColleagueAI has no access and is not processor of that data.

CRA.name: Cyber Resilience Act, Regulation (EU) 2024/2847
CRA.applies: Likely yes for a distributed software package (counsel to confirm 'product with digital elements' and the role as manufacturer). Art. 14 reporting since 11 Sep 2026; Art. 13 and Annex I from 11 Dec 2027.

ISO42001.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI management system
ISO42001.access: paid; licensed copy needed to verify
ISO42001.applies: Voluntary reference. No certification held or claimed.

ISO27001.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 information security management
ISO27001.applies: Voluntary reference. No certification held or claimed.

ISO27701.name: ISO/IEC 27701 privacy information management (edition to be confirmed at purchase)
ISO27701.applies: Voluntary reference; future coverage only if a privacy management system is adopted.

ISO23894.name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 AI risk management guidance
ISO23894.applies: Voluntary reference for D01, D16 method.

ISO31000.name: ISO 31000:2018 risk management guidelines
ISO31000.applies: Voluntary reference for the risk method.

NIST.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST AI 100-1) and Generative AI Profile (NIST AI 600-1)

OWASP.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025 and OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations
OWASP.applies: Voluntary reference; the D07/D13 adversarial test set is organised by it.

D01.ref: Art. 4, 5, 6 and Annex III screening; Art. 9 (reference)

D02.ref: Art. 14 (reference; binding only if high-risk); Art. 26(2) deployer

D06.ref: whole Regulation (monitoring of amendments, delegated and implementing acts)

D08.ref: Annex I part II vulnerability handling

D11.ref: Art. 15; Art. 25 value chain; Art. 53 (Microsoft as GPAI provider)

D12.ref: Art. 13(5) due diligence on components; Annex I part II SBOM

D14.ref: Annex I part II (secure distribution of updates)
